limitations: Production is a benchmark model profile, not production incident authority or readiness certification.
Five selected controlled fault-injection cases repeat across three rounds; these are not 15 independent incidents.
Machine service and fault-label matches do not establish causal correctness.
Human causal, mechanism-compatibility, privacy-impact and completion review remains pending.
The baseline is not asked to produce a formal finding; finding counts are not a shared accuracy endpoint.
Both conditions use schema finalization; there is no prompt-versus-schema control.
Earlier snapshots remain separate; model, protocol, prompt and budget differences prevent isolating a model-only effect.
The host exposes a model identifier, not an immutable backend build.
Digests identify private supporting artifacts but are not retrievable links or a complete public replay archive.
The snapshot excludes raw telemetry, prompts, model narratives, mechanism excerpts, captures, approvals, session IDs, host paths and reveal links.
Consumption value is not necessarily incremental billing; the monitored budget is not a hard billing guarantee.
